description:
The Sienna’s Perfect Fit™ steel frame is designed for ultimate comfort. It promotes a natural, upright riding position to reduce strain on your back and shoulders, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable journey every time.
The Sienna is equipped with a Shimano 7-speed drivetrain, making every ride seamless and efficient. Whether tackling hills or cruising flat paths, the smooth gear transitions ensure a comfortable and controlled experience for young riders.
The Sienna features dual-density comfort grips that provide a secure and cushioned hold for every ride. Combined with the Shimano Revoshift twist shifter, changing gears is smooth and effortless, ensuring a comfortable and enjoyable biking experience.
The Sienna’s deluxe padded saddle offers exceptional comfort for longer rides. Its ergonomic design and premium stitching not only enhance durability but also add a touch of style to your cycling adventures.

components.description: Linear pull brakes provide reliable stopping power for safe, confident control on every ride.
